description:
Medium finding from the 2808 review (NOT yet verified by anyone; reproduce first): review a head on develop, retarget the PR elsewhere, then retarget back to develop without changing the head. plan_round (_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/protocol.py about lines 316-327) skips because that SHA already has a decision, while oracle_review_check.decide (_project/scripts/oracle_review_check.py about line 133) excludes reviews that predate the latest base-change event, so the check reports WAITING; manual retries also skip; recovery needs another head change or a stand-in. Related to the dropped item oracle-pull-request-target-retarget-race-20261008 (accepted risk because only one write collaborator exists) but this is a liveness bug, not a forgery risk.

DECISION GATE: reproduce with a replay of the event sequence first (unit test through plan_round and decide). If the sequence cannot occur (retargeting back re-triggers a pull_request event that carries a fresh review), record that evidence and finish with no change. Otherwise make plan_round re-review (or carry with a fresh review record) when the latest base-change event is newer than the stored decision, without weakening the check's exclusion of pre-retarget reviews.
